scope: Isolated ARM64 execution of original translated input handler, native bridge queue/snapshots/loading scopes and pure-memory original night/camera routines; no game assets, window, preferences, race rendering or visual gameplay were used.
limitations: PIONEER tested through original recognizer and native whitelist only because its activation opens a resource-dependent modal dialog.
MAD and KCJONES are accepted original no-op entries in this software-rendered executable.
In-race driving/rendering, heavier-car record entry and barrier-jump triggers require separate runtime or source verification.
